build_dataflow_graph_with_gradients: build a dataflow graph with forward pass operators, loss node, gradient propagation, and gradient application nodes
create_graph_add_node: create a graph node with a name and optional size using graph.add_node
create_graph_add_edge: create a named edge connecting source nodes to sink nodes with a specified size
run_graph_canonicalize: run graph.canonicalize to normalize the dataflow graph structure after adding nodes and edges
review_graph_with_gradients: review the dataflow graph that models forward pass, backward gradient propagation, and weight update operations
